Hi coaches, Kenneth Bastians believes in the power of sport and coaching. He's enthusiastic about growing and activating the potential of coaches and sporting federations. Coaching for more than 25 years, Kenneth has coached from grass roots through to the elite level players. As a master in sports training and with a background of 15 years of high performance player development in Belgian tennis, Kenneth uses his unique experience and expertise to improve sport development with a creative and cutting edge approach. In 2014, Kenneth founded his company, Coach to Competence, Activate Your Potential and created multi-skills, skills for sports and life. Multi-skills is a cross sport athletic skill development method that has been adopted by several federations throughout Europe and the UK. Coach to Competence has developed sport specific development programs to improve children's skills in sport. Kenneth has also created a pathway and content of LTI Youth, a kids tennis program for Great Britain. Please join me in welcoming Kenneth as he presents an innovative approach to skill acquisition
